stdinScript:
set +e
run() { printf '\n=== '; printf '%q ' "$@"; echo '==='; date -u --iso-8601=seconds; "$@"; rc=$?; echo "exitCode=$rc"; }
run swanctl --list-conns
run swanctl --list-sas
run ip -d link show type xfrm
run ip route show table all
run ip rule show
run ip route get 10.244.1.4 from 10.246.1.1
run vtysh -c 'show bgp ipv4 unicast summary'
run vtysh -c 'show bgp ipv4 unicast'
run vtysh -c 'show bgp ipv4 unicast 10.244.0.0/16'
run vtysh -c 'show bgp ipv4 unicast neighbors'
run vtysh -c 'show route-map'
run vtysh -c 'show ip prefix-list'
run vtysh -c 'show ip route'
for peer in 10.244.255.7 10.244.255.6 169.254.21.2 169.254.22.2; do
 run vtysh -c "show bgp ipv4 unicast neighbors $peer routes"
 run vtysh -c "show bgp ipv4 unicast neighbors $peer advertised-routes"
 run ip route get "$peer"
done
for outer in 10.244.255.4 10.244.255.5 4.165.162.61 4.165.90.255; do run ip route get "$outer"; done
run systemctl cat vnbgp-network vnbgp-ipsec strongswan frr
textNormalization: LF line endings; trailing spaces removed.
assessment: One unsupported 'show bgp ipv4 unicast neighbors' command is preserved with exitCode=1; full details captured successfully with 'show bgp neighbors' in cpe-neighbors-all.txt.
